tasks.q: When is the output of an AND gate 1?
tasks.fb: Both inputs have to be true.

tasks.q: Complete the truth table for A AND B. Click each ? to change it to 0 or 1.
tasks.fb: Only the last row, where both inputs are 1, outputs 1.

tasks.q: When is the output of an OR gate 0?
tasks.fb: One true input is enough to make OR output 1.

tasks.q: Complete the truth table for A OR B.
tasks.fb: Only the first row, where both inputs are 0, outputs 0.

tasks.q: What does a NOT gate do?
a: Reverses its input: 1 becomes 0, and 0 becomes 1
tasks.fb: NOT is also called an inverter.

tasks.q: Complete the truth table for NOT A.
Match each symbol to its operator.
tasks.fb: You'll see these symbols in exam questions.

tasks.q: What does the cash machine program output?
tasks.fb: Both conditions are true, so the AND is true.

tasks.q: Build the circuit for Q = A AND C.
tasks.fb: One AND gate, with inputs A and C.

tasks.q: Build the circuit for Q = (A OR B) AND C.
tasks.fb: The OR gate's output feeds one input of the AND gate.

tasks.q: In NOT A OR B, which part is worked out first?
a: They're all worked out at once
tasks.fb: NOT applies only to the thing right after it, unless there are brackets.

tasks.q: Build the circuit for Q = NOT A OR B.
tasks.fb: NOT A feeds one input of the OR gate.

tasks.q: Build the circuit for Q = NOT (A AND B).
tasks.fb: The AND gate's output goes into the NOT gate.

tasks.q: Build the circuit for Q = (A AND B) OR (C AND D).
tasks.fb: Two AND gates feed one OR gate.

tasks.q: Write the Boolean expression for this logic diagram.
tasks.fb: The OR gate comes first, then its output is reversed.

info.title: George Boole
info.text: Boolean logic is named after George Boole, an English mathematician who described this kind of algebra in 1854, long before computers existed.

info.title: Made of transistors
info.text: Inside a CPU, logic gates are built from transistors, tiny electronic switches. A modern CPU contains billions of them.

info.title: Claude Shannon
info.text: In 1937, a student called Claude Shannon showed that Boole's logic could be built with electrical switches. That idea is the basis of every digital computer.

info.title: Search engines
info.text: Many search engines and library catalogues let you use AND, OR and NOT to narrow down your search results.

info.title: One gate to rule them all
info.text: A NAND gate (NOT AND) is 'universal': any other gate, and so any computer, can be built using only NAND gates.

info.title: 1 and 0
info.text: True and false, on and off, 1 and 0: they all mean the same thing in logic. Computers use the voltage in a wire to represent them.
